news.headline: TCG Crossover and Chen Yu Report 7.0% ADS Stake in Abivax
news.summary: Biotech crossover investor TCG Crossover (Chen Yu) disclosed beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, across its Fund I (5.7%) and Fund II (1.3%). A specialist fund holding a sizeable passive stake after the July offering is a supportive sign, even as Bank of America and Goldman Sachs trimmed their positions in mid-October filings.

news.headline: Abivax to Present Seven Obefazimod Abstracts at UEG Week 2026, Including Full ABTECT Maintenance Results
news.summary: Abivax will present four oral presentations and three posters at UEG Week in Barcelona (October 17-20), led by the Phase 3 ABTECT Maintenance efficacy and safety results, maintenance outcomes in treatment-experienced patients and three-year Phase 2 follow-up with dose de-escalation to 25 mg. This is the first full medical-meeting presentation of the Week-44 data and safety database since the June malignancy debate.

news.headline: Analysts Slash Forecasts on Abivax Following H1 Results; Wedbush Cuts Target to $118
news.summary: Several analysts lowered price targets after the H1 report, with Wedbush cutting to $118 (Neutral), arguing a 2026 NDA filing and possible 2027 approval are already priced in, and Truist trimming to $151 (Buy). Consensus remains well above the share price, at roughly $155-164 on average.

news.headline: Abivax Presents Business Updates and First Half 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Pro-forma cash is about EUR 1.17bn (EUR 402.4m at June 30 plus EUR 767.1m from the July offering), extending runway into Q4 2029, and the NDA for obefazimod in UC remains planned by end-2026, with Crohn's ENHANCE-CD topline in mid-2027. Abivax also completed a EUR 76.5m royalty-certificate buy-back and named Chris Rabbat CMO (succeeding Fabio Cataldi) and Tim Kelly CTO; R&D spend rose 38% to EUR 107.9m.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Coverage of Abivax with Buy Rating and $155 Price Target
news.summary: Goldman Sachs started coverage at Buy with a $155 target, modelling peak obefazimod sales of about EUR 4bn in ulcerative colitis plus EUR 3.5bn potential in Crohn's disease, and said the maintenance-trial cancer signal should not impede approval or long-term uptake. The bank also flagged Abivax as a potential acquisition target while calling a solo launch viable after the July financing.

news.headline: STAT: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.summary: STAT's Adam Feuerstein dissected why, nine months into a record biotech M&A year in which a roughly $20bn takeout of Abivax was widely treated as imminent, no deal has materialised - to the visible frustration of the shareholder base. The piece frames the delay as timing and process rather than a broken thesis, noting obefazimod's blockbuster commercial potential in ulcerative colitis remains intact.

catalysts.label: UEG Week 2026 (Barcelona) - ABTECT maintenance oral presented Oct 19; release pending
catalysts.detail: The Phase 3 ABTECT 44-week maintenance efficacy and safety oral was scheduled for October 19 (10:50-11:00, Hot Topics in Clinical GI Research), followed by the three-year Phase 2 25 mg de-escalation follow-up (12:00-12:10); a maintenance outcomes oral in treatment-experienced patients follows on October 20. As of the morning of October 19 Abivax had issued no press release with the presented data and there was no reported market reaction yet. How investigators read the detailed malignancy/safety database is the key swing factor before the year-end NDA filing.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive ABTECT induction and Week-44 maintenance data and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, Abivax reiterated in its September 21 H1 report that it plans to submit the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active UC by end-2026. This is the biggest near-term de-risking event and starts the FDA review clock; FDA acceptance (about 60 days after submission) would likely follow in Q1 2027, before the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists Q3 2026 results for December 14, 2026. By then the NDA should have been submitted or be days away, making the release the natural venue to confirm the filing and give guidance on review type and expected PDUFA timing. It is the last scheduled financial update before the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax earlier guided to a European Marketing Authorization Application in H2 2026, but the September 21 H1 report gave no EMA timing and focused solely on the end-2026 FDA filing, so the MAA looks likely to slip into 2027. A European filing would open the second-largest UC market; timing remains unconfirmed.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027, reconfirmed in the H1 2026 report. A positive readout would open a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism, but it likely lands just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: With an end-2026 filing and a standard review, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, in H2 2027 - after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet. Abivax is building its U.S. commercial organisation against this window with about EUR 1.17bn of pro-forma cash.

pulse: ABVX last closed at $88.13 on October 16 (market cap about $7.7bn), down from about $118 in mid-September after H1-driven target cuts and fading takeover hopes, and below the July offering price of $125 despite a consensus target near $159. The decisive ABTECT maintenance and safety oral is being presented at UEG Week on October 19, but no Abivax data release or market reaction had appeared yet; the next hard catalysts are the planned end-2026 NDA submission and Q3 results on December 14. The March-2027 $120 call is about 27% out of the money and needs roughly +36% in five months, so a well-received UEG read-through, an on-time NDA filing or a revived M&A story are the realistic paths to the strike.
